item.description:
Kipowi 0.8.0

  • A level meter on the picture, with LUFS, so you can see how loud a clip really is. Turn it off in Settings.
  • Loudness normalize on export — brings a quiet video up to a sensible level instead of leaving it quiet.
  • Take the sound out of a video, or drop it entirely.
  • Zoom the waveform. It follows the timeline now, down to twenty milliseconds, and the detail is read off the file rather than stretched — so you can pick exactly the piece you want to export.
  • A marked stretch is much easier to see: it is drawn as a frame rather than a faint wash, on the waveform and on the timeline, and it follows the system's Increase contrast setting.
  • Marking a second part of a sound no longer switches Multiple selections on by itself. Most second marks are a change of mind, and every one of them was leaving a selection behind. Press the button when you want to collect marks; the one you have already made is kept.
  • The Level slider says it is monitoring only, and the deck no longer shifts about when gain is applied or the window is made small.
